content: In the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk, commenting on Q 17:82 (We send down of the Quran that which is a healing and a mercy), Ibn Turka says the quranic letters bring two benefits: bodily healing, restoring the body's balance, and, once the body is balanced, an ascent through the rungs of existence from estrangement toward nearness to God. Melvin-Koushki presents this as showing the interdependency of the practical and theoretical modes.
